Name: MATCHING_FINALFANTASY_SPRITES_AND_PORTRAITS
Author: Melanchophosis
Description:
[font=Courier New](CP) MATCHING FINAL FANTASY SPRITES AND PORTRAITS!

*This mod was created by mixing and adapting two mods that I already loved:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30139]Peach Yogurt’s Sprites[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/118]Dreamlike’s Portraits[/url].

I edited Peach Yogurt’s sprites to make them match the style of Dreamlike’s.

“What is required to install the mod?”

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]

Instructions on how to install the mod are included in the file.

I do not intend to make any profit from this mod!

[/font]PT-BR
